dedupe_keys.name: dataset learning to solve large scale security constrained unit commitment problems

description: Álinson Santos Xavier, Feng Qiu and Shabbir Ahmed publish instance data used to test machine learning for security-constrained unit commitment. The February 2020 Zenodo archive is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0 and names the associated INFORMS Journal on Computing study. Its experiments use realistic large-scale network instances, reaching 6,515 buses and 1,388 generating units, to assess predicted constraints, warm starts and reduced decision spaces. These inputs can benchmark scheduling algorithms while keeping physical and operational constraints explicit. They are study instances, not a current operational grid inventory. The landing page does not specify internal formats or enumerate every system and time horizon. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Solver-runtime improvements and tolerance to distribution shifts are study claims, not independently verified performance. The archive and model execution were not inspected.
